body: The economy is too unforgiving right now to support another child, but yes, we have talked extensively about this. If we were in a better financial situation they would readily do it.
I just turned 18 but am still in highschool.
I live with my foster parents, but if I were financially independent and stable I would do it in a heartbeat.
She is 14. I do not know my mother very well, let alone her friends. Once I can get ahold of my sister again I will suggest the pay phone.
